problem_restatement.input: During the first V58 live window, BTC, ETH, SOL, and HYPE all appreciated materially while only ETH supplied effective long authority. BTC had two short-only routes plus a rare downside-sweep long, SOL and HYPE produced no eligible entries, and the two V58 ETH longs stopped for a combined loss.
problem_restatement.output: Falsify one slow four-asset long-participation sleeve designed to retain broad bullish beta without replacing the existing selective alpha routes.
problem_restatement.stakeholder: Operator pursuing aggressive but evidence-bound growth from approximately 5000 USD of live capital.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Determine whether the frozen mechanism produces positive, largest-winner-robust, stress-surviving portfolio economics across chronological opened partitions while capturing sustained broad uptrends with explicit downside and profit-giveback exits.

hypothesis: When at least three of BTC, ETH, SOL, and HYPE simultaneously maintain completed-hour close above EMA21 above EMA55, long exposure in each individually aligned asset may capture persistent crypto beta more reliably than routes requiring a fresh downside sweep, squeeze release, or compression onset.
claim_boundaries: This is a portfolio beta hypothesis, not a claim of asset-specific alpha.
The observed August 2026 rally motivated the coverage diagnosis and is therefore diagnostic-only, not confirmation evidence.
The three historical partitions were previously opened by other project research and are not pristine holdouts.
No candidate historical trade, return, PnL, win rate, or drawdown was inspected before this contract was written.
A positive backtest would not by itself authorize live execution.

mechanism_novelty.closest_rejected_family: BTC cross-sectional breadth expansion used fresh 90-minute normalized-return alignment plus dispersion expansion to predict only BTC's next 60 minutes.
mechanism_novelty.material_difference: The candidate is a persistent four-asset allocation state based on each asset's own completed-hour price level and 21/55 trend structure, holds for days rather than one hour, executes each aligned asset separately, and exits on slow trend deterioration, protective loss, or profit giveback.
mechanism_novelty.falsifier: A prior project artifact with the same four-asset persistent state, entry/exit state machine, and portfolio economics must be reconciled before result publication.

parameter_provenance.ema_21_55: existing project completed-hour trend convention used by multiple active and rejected mechanisms
parameter_provenance.entry_breadth_three: single majority-of-four hypothesis matching the observed portfolio-wide coverage failure; no alternative breadth values will be tested
parameter_provenance.exit_breadth_two: single hysteresis boundary preventing one-asset weakness from liquidating the full sleeve while exiting when a majority no longer qualifies
parameter_provenance.protective_stop_300bps: single wide structural-loss bound intended to avoid the demonstrated 60bps bull-pullback churn; no stop grid will be tested
parameter_provenance.profit_giveback: single completed-hour 600bps activation, 100bps minimum locked gain, and 400bps trailing distance; no profit-lock grid will be tested
parameter_provenance.maximum_hold_30d: operational fallback rather than the primary exit

partition_disclosure: All partitions have been opened by prior project work. Results can provide chronological replication and falsification but not clean confirmation. No parameter may be selected from any partition.

explicit_support_criteria.trial_abort_policy: Only technical integrity failure aborts result publication. Losing, sparse, high-drawdown, or zero-trade outcomes remain published results.

uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: The candidate may simply add leveraged crypto beta and lose during broad reversals.
Cross-asset correlation can make four nominal positions behave like one concentrated position.
A 300bps stop may still cluster across all assets and create an approximately 2.4 percent gross portfolio stop wave before costs.
Completed-hour exits can surrender substantial intrahour profit or gap below the modeled stop.
Opened historical partitions and extensive prior project search create substantial multiple-testing risk.
The observed August rally may have unconsciously influenced the fixed specification despite the one-shot contract.
One-minute bars cannot establish authentic historical mark trigger ordering, visible depth, or receipt latency.
Persistent positive funding may consume a material fraction of trend returns.
falsifiers: Any source has a missing, duplicate, non-Hyperliquid, or misaligned minute or funding settlement.
Implementation differs from the frozen decision, next-hour entry, rearm, stop, profit-lock, exit, sizing, fee, funding, or slippage contract.
Independent reconstruction changes any signal, trade, partition aggregate, or source identity.
The continuous-long beta baseline dominates while the candidate does not materially reduce drawdown or adverse exposure, indicating an unnecessary timing layer.
Prospective observer decisions disagree with completed source bars or modeled fills are not feasible at target size.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Implement and independently reproduce the exact one-shot historical replay without opening another parameter set.
explicit_approval_requested: None for report-only research. Any later live profile mutation requires a separate exact approval request.
